title: Wonderful Words of Life
lyrics: [F]Sing them over [C7]again to me, wonderful words of [F]life,
[F]Let me more of their [C7]beauty see, wonderful words of [F]life;
[F]Words of life and [Bb]beauty teach me faith and duty.
[F]Christ, the blessed One, [C]gives to all wonderful words of [F]life;
[F]Sinner, list to the [C]loving call, wonderful words of [F]life;
All so freely [Bb]given, wooing us to heaven.
[F]Sweetly echo the [C]Gospel call, wonderful words of [F]life;
[F]Offer pardon and [C]peace to all, wonderful words of [F]life;
